title: Cross-chain operation intent
description: What the user asked for. intentId = keccak256(canonical JSON of this object without intentId). Canonical JSON: UTF-8, object keys sorted by code point, no insignificant whitespace, ASCII-only content. Semantic rules not expressible here are listed in spec/README.md and enforced by libs/crosschain-types.

amount.description: Raw amount in SOURCE network units (Stellar USDC: 7 decimals; EVM USDC: 6).

recipient.description: Final recipient on the destination network. Bound into intentId; a relayer cannot change it.

refundRecipient.description: Where unconsumed funds return, on the source network.

maxFee.description: Upper bound on all fees (CCTP fee plus relayer fee) in source units.

actionDeadline.description: After this time the destination ACTION must not execute. It never cancels a burn: delivery continues and minted funds stay recoverable.

deliveryTimeoutSecs.description: When the UI escalates a still-undelivered transfer to recovery. Not a cancellation.

nonce.description: Per-positionOwner replay nonce for the execution action.
